👀 DeepSeek just gave AI agents eyes

DeepSeek has released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal model that brings vision to its V4-Flash capabilities.

The model reportedly matches V4-Flash on text tasks like reasoning, agents, and world knowledge, while making a big jump on multimodal agent benchmarks, pushing performance close to Opus-4.8.

That means AI agents can now understand images while using tools, opening up workflows that previously required separate vision models.
